_meta.status: Oct 29 IV/IO and fluids values from OCT28_MEDICAL_ANSWERS section 7. Textbook anchors (ATLS / TCCC / NREMT / PHTLS). Needs sign-off from a certified medic before Nov 4.
_meta.basis: ATLS / TCCC / NREMT / PHTLS textbook anchors. Fields tagged TUNE are adjustable for gameplay.

pressureBag.note: Pressure bag at 300 mmHg is about 1.5-2x gravity flow.

modifiers_pct.shockMeans: ATLS Class II or worse (loss 15 percent or more). Engine definition.
modifiers_pct.movingRigNote: No moving rig on Oct 29 (no transport phase). Parked until Oct 30.
modifiers_pct.darkOrRainNote: Applies at night roadside (Bike down is night). Scene lighting does not fully offset it.
modifiers_pct.largeGaugeSmallVeinMeans_TUNE: 14g or 16g in a hand vein. Engine definition.

ivStart.infiltrationNote: An infiltrated line stops delivering and the site swells.

io.consciousLidocaineNote: Conscious patient: lidocaine 40 mg IO before the flush, or the pain hits 10/10.
contraindications: Infection or burn at the site
IO in the same bone within 48 h

dripSets.formula: gtt per min = mL per h x drop factor / 60
dripSets.oct29behavior: L1/L2 run wide open at catheter gravity flow (x pressure bag if applied). The menu shows the gtt math for the running rate.

fluids.note: Fluids are NOT tokens. Model them explicitly.
fluids.crystalloid_decay: Exponential to 250 mL retained over 60 min. retained(t) = 250 + 750 x e^(-0.077 x t_min). Engine fit to the stated curve.
fluids.bloodNote: Blood products stay about 90 percent intravascular.
fluids.bloodRequires: Blood tubing with a filter, and a warmer at 38 C.
